name: Pedestal 3D
description: Pedestal 3D: one hero object on a glossy reflective floor under studio HDRI light, slow turntable and punch-in camera moves, exploded views where parts fly apart with thin callout lines, cinematic dip transitions. Apple-keynote calm with gold accents. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 5-9 scenes (4-6 s each) about ONE product or object. Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "scene3d": a single hero object (phone, laptop, card, coin, battery, chip, rocket, lightbulb, model, icon) or a hero + 2-4 parts with explode: true and short labels as callouts. Use stat for the key spec number. Never use emoji.
